title: Research trajectory and long-term trends of dissolved organic carbon in freshwater systems
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00244G, Critical Review
Liping Hu, Kun Shi
Rising dissolved organic carbon in lakes/rivers due to climate change, acid deposition recovery, and human activities, causes water quality decline, biodiversity loss, and greenhouse gas emissions. Solutions: source control, monitoring, restoration.
